name: chatgtm
description: High-volume, high-customization outbound sales engine (ChatGTM). Set a leadership-owned segment lock, pull prospects from your own enrichment tool, gate every email on a verifiable signal, and draft outreach that does not read as AI. Ships with absolute guardrails: drafts only (never sends), read-only CRM, providers receive only the target filter, and all information stays local. Tool-agnostic: connect your own CRM, mailbox, and enrichment provider during setup.
